subject: Nanotechnology
title: Nano Pyroelectric Harvesting
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Nano Pyroelectric Harvesting.

hook.text: Temperature fluctuations throughout the day are untapped energy — pyroelectric nanofilms harvest every swing.

buildup.text: Pyroelectric materials generate current when temperature changes — not from a gradient, but from the rate of change.

discovery.text: PVDF nanofiber mats have high pyroelectric coefficients — flexible films that generate power from thermal cycling.

twist.text: Constant temperature produces zero output — the harvester only works during transitions, not steady states.

climax.text: Coupled pyro-piezoelectric nanogenerators harvest both heat swings and vibrations — dual-mode energy scavenging.

punchline.text: Every temperature swing is wasted energy — a nano film captures it.

quiz.question: How do pyroelectric nanogenerators differ from thermoelectric ones?
options: They generate power from the rate of temperature change, not a static temperature gradient
They require higher temperatures to operate
They only work in a vacuum
